questions.q: What does the App Launcher (the grid icon in the top-left) do?
options: Opens a screen showing every app installed in the org, so you can switch between them
Deletes the currently open record
Opens Salesforce's billing settings
Logs the user out of Salesforce
questions.explain: The App Launcher opens the full App Launcher screen, split into All Apps and All Items, for switching between installed apps.

questions.q: What happens when you click a tab like "Opportunities" on the navigation bar?
options: It opens a list view — a filtered, sortable table of many Opportunity records at once
It opens exactly one specific Opportunity record, chosen at random
It immediately deletes all Opportunities
It opens the App Launcher
questions.explain: Clicking a tab opens a list view, a filtered table of many records from that object, not a single record.

questions.q: What is the global search bar used for, per this lesson?
options: Looking across many objects at once (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Cases, etc.) to find a specific record fast
Only searching within the currently open record
Searching the AppExchange for new apps to install
Changing a user's password
questions.explain: Global search spans multiple objects at once, making it the fastest way to jump straight to one specific record.

questions.q: If not all of an app's tabs fit across the navigation bar, where do the extra ones go, per this lesson?
options: They collapse under a "More" dropdown
They are permanently deleted from the org
They move to the AppExchange
They become custom fields
questions.explain: Tabs that don't fit across the navigation bar collapse under a "More" dropdown menu.

questions.q: Why does this lesson connect the App Launcher back to Sales Cloud vs. Service Cloud from Lesson 2?
options: Because the App Launcher is literally how a user switches between different apps, like Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, built on the same platform
Because the App Launcher only exists in Service Cloud
Because Sales Cloud and Service Cloud use completely separate navigation bars with no relation
Because the App Launcher was renamed to Sales Cloud in a recent update
questions.explain: The App Launcher is the real mechanism for switching between apps like Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, and any AppExchange-installed apps.
